text:
Lina (CSM): Heads up — Kestrel Health hit a 35% drop in generate calls after the CSV import step in onboarding. I built a quick friction heatmap, see the top 3 pain points. Need a micro-intercept plan to avoid them churning at trial end.
Monica (Success Ops): Can you paste the heatmap screenshot or the rows you used?
Lina (CSM): Pasted the summary below — high drop at: file upload -> mapping -> first successful generate. Most failures are mapping errors + 413 responses.
onboarding-bot: New triage ticket created: #TR-8342 (Kestrel Health onboarding drop). Assigned to: Dev Team & Enablement.
Devon (Success Ops): Quick triage steps: 1) confirm if CSV size limit is hitting them, 2) try a small sample import for mapping step, 3) confirm logs for 413 vs mapping mismatch.
Raj (Engineer): I see a 413 at the proxy when Content-Length > 4MB. We should either increase limit for onboarding routes or provide client-side chunking. Short-term I can catch their account and bump limit for them.
Lina (CSM): Can you bump for kestrel@kestrel.health? Trial ends in 6 days. If we can get them past mapping they use the product.
Raj (Engineer): Will do. Pushing temp config change now. If anyone needs to test, here is a quick curl to hit the staging import endpoint:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/api/import 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN' 
  -F 'file=@sample.csv'
  -F 'account=kestrel@kestrel.health'
```
Ava (Enablement): I'll set a 20-min mapping onboarding session with Lina and the customer tonight so we can walk through mapping rules and confirm expected outputs.
Monica (Success Ops): Suggest adding a preflight client validation script to the onboarding kit to surface mapping mismatches earlier. Ava, can we add a 1-click sample validator to the enablement guide?
Ava (Enablement): Yep — I'll add a small JS snippet and a GIF showing column name expectations. Will link in the ticket.
Lina (CSM): Also proposing a short retention gesture if we hit this: extend trial by 7 days + a quick 1:1. Thoughts?
Devon (Success Ops): Good idea. Approve +7 days for account scope: kestrel@kestrel.health. I'll coordinate with billing to apply.
Raj (Engineer): Bumped the proxy limit for their account. Monitoring for errors now. I also filed a follow-up PR to add chunking support to the client lib (ETA 3 days).
Lina (CSM): Great — action items: Raj (bump + PR), Ava (mapping session + docs), Devon (trial extension + billing), Monica (add preflight snippet), Lina (customer follow-up + meeting).
Monica (Success Ops): I'll own the micro-intercept checklist and close TR-8342 when mapping session confirmed and first successful generate seen.
Lina (CSM): Thanks team. I'll send a short template msg to the customer now: 
"Hey Kestrel — saw an import hiccup. We’ve enabled a temporary limit for your account and booked a short mapping walkthrough tonight. We’ll extend your trial by 7 days to make sure nothing is rushed. — Lina"
Ava (Enablement): +1 to the msg. Please cc onboarding@redwood.ai so we can prep.
Raj (Engineer): FYI logging spike looks resolved after the bump. Will post final note once PR merged.
onboarding-bot: TR-8342 status update: in_progress -> monitoring.
Lina (CSM): Closing loop later today with results. If successful, we should capture this as a micro-intercept template for similar import-driven onboarding drops. Can someone add to the CS playbook?
Monica (Success Ops): I’ll add the template + heatmap artifact under /playbooks/onboarding-micro-intercepts.
Lina (CSM): Perfect — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
